claims.statement: Every genuine Boolean function of Fourier degree at most two satisfies G(f) <= 2 I(f) in every dimension.
claims.quantifiers: all finite uniform cubes; all Boolean f with Fourier degree <= 2

claims.statement: Every genuine Boolean function of Fourier degree at most two satisfies H(f) <= 2 I(f), sharply.
A dimension-minimal positive-residual counterexample to G <= 4 I + 3 U / 4 must have Fourier degree at least three.
